purpose: Rollback anchor taken immediately BEFORE the R-134 migration-history repair. These 6 rows are the complete contents of supabase_migrations.schema_migrations at that moment. If a repair or push must be undone, delete every row whose version is NOT in this list to return the bookkeeping table to its exact prior state.
note: Deleting bookkeeping rows only rewinds migration HISTORY, never schema. Schema changes applied by db push are NOT undone by restoring this file; those must be reverted with a forward migration.
